title: bidens occidentalis
intro: Bidens occidentalis, commonly known as Western beggar lice, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues, including skin conditions, wounds, and fever. The health benefits of Bidens occidentalis include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe skin irritations, reduce pain and swelling, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Bidens occidentalis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
